axioms.name: Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem
axioms.statement: No consistent formal system capable of expressing arithmetic can prove its own consistency
axioms.formal: ∀ consistent system S with arithmetic: ¬(S ⊢ Con(S))

axioms.name: Angle Trisection Impossibility
axioms.statement: General angle trisection is impossible with compass and straightedge alone
violations: trisect any angle with compass and straightedge

axioms.name: Squaring the Circle Impossibility
axioms.statement: Constructing a square with the same area as a given circle using compass and straightedge is impossible

axioms.name: Uncountability of Real Numbers
axioms.statement: The real numbers cannot be put in one-to-one correspondence with the natural numbers

open_conjectures.name: Riemann Hypothesis
open_conjectures.statement: All non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2
open_conjectures.implication: Claims to prove or disprove should be FLAGGED for expert review
